adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: The severe insulin-resistance phenotype plus biallelic INSR variants identifies Donohue syndrome; INSR is a cell-surface receptor with intrinsic tyrosine kinase activity.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Gs-coupled GPCRs, JAK-STAT cytokine receptors, intracellular nuclear receptors and serine/threonine kinase receptors are distinct signaling classes from the insulin receptor.
